identity.name: Osmanlı Bankası Bursa Şubesi / Bursa İttihat ve Terakki Kulübü (aynı yıkılan yapı)

estimatedFootprint.method: hand-estimated from dated street and Koza Han photographs, centred near KE map marker and oriented to current street axis

limits: The historic building has no extant M5 DGN footprint in this work.
KE's two entries refer to the same historic building but their markers differ by about 40.5 m; neither is a surveyed footprint.
The 1930 Koza-facing dome and entrance stairs were removed in 1934, when the Art Deco street entrance was added.
Street and Koza Han facade dimensions, connecting plan, roof and dome are interpretive estimates.
Current Atatürk Cd. alignment is a placement aid and may differ from the 1940s street.
